Result: Resolve the actual source38 PowerShell startup failure and verify the smallest Windows launch arrangement that permits both script execution and cleanup after controller loss.

Starting condition: Source 38c21a77b4e875d75e17ee68683846601df33591 failed the actual PC tray check at 2026-11-25T03:34:50Z with 7,771,205,632 free bytes, peak 218,394,624 owned resident bytes and no accepted case. PowerShell exited 0 before READY, server startup or the click fixture's final receipt. A later controller-identity error occurred after that controller exited; subsequent reads found all three recorded PIDs absent and port 43971 free. The older non-detached launch had passed real Exit but failed parent-loss cache removal. Preserve both failures.

Match Node v25.2.1/libuv source at nodejs/node commit 4cac2b94bed4bf02810be054e8f63c0048c66564, deps/uv/src/win/process.c, plus primary reports nodejs/node#51018, PowerShell/PowerShell#28383 and oven-sh/bun#31603.

Prerequisites: Complete independent acceptance of this revision, under the existing plan-review key. Reopen this existing task and affected closed outputs with guarded transitions; the accepted provisional-dispatch rule below allows independent cloud preparation while native changes await the PC.

Steps:
1. Read all retained raw and decoded results. Treat raw Windows file hashes separately from UTF-8 encodings of decoded text. Confirm the early PowerShell exit is the first product failure; do not present the later CIM race as its cause.
2. Trace DETACHED_PROCESS, CREATE_NO_WINDOW and libuv's parent-held Job behavior in the pinned source. Freeze a small hosted-Windows probe on a task-only branch: Node 25.2.1; ordinary Windows PowerShell; shell:false, windowsHide:true and three pipes; no Forms, Next server, native database or user-PC access.
3. The probe compares direct attached and direct detached PowerShell marker execution, then a detached Node host spawning attached hidden PowerShell. It must record exact arguments/options, versions, PIDs, exit codes, stdout/stderr and entry/finally markers. Its last bounded case forcibly ends only its own disposable controller after readiness and verifies the Node host lets PowerShell observe controller loss, finish its final marker and exit. Retain pipe references, use at most 128 MiB per Node heap, a 15-second per-case deadline, a 120-second overall script deadline and a five-minute hosted job. Validate every expected marker and require owned process cleanup. Failures stay visible.
4. Independently review the complete probe and workflow before activation. Run once on a fresh hosted Windows job. Read all actual output; no PC retry is needed to establish this launch mechanism. A failed probe returns a concrete correction for review before another run.
5. If the hosted result establishes the arrangement, return a diagnosis tied to exact source and actual observations and authorize the separate tray-repair task to implement the specified Node host. If it does not, keep this task and dependent acceptance open and revise the concrete repair through complete-plan review.

Required checks and completion: Complete retained failure analysis plus a passing bounded hosted marker/parent-loss probe on the exact Node version; no surviving owned process. This check establishes Windows process behavior and does not replace the real tray menu/restart/cache check.

Permissions and limits: Root alone writes canonical task state and uses Emergency Maintenance on the PC. Use GitHub task branches and hosted runners while the cloud filesystem is unavailable. Protect foreground Unreal/VR work: no PC compilation, GPU use, visible UI control, broad process termination, service restarts or unrelated changes. Actual PC app checks remain sequential, hidden and BelowNormal; require 3 GiB free physical RAM immediately before launch, keep each Node heap at or below 256 MiB and count every owned driver, controller, Node tray host, PowerShell helper, server and child in the 512 MiB aggregate resident-memory limit. Stop only this check's processes on deadline, excess memory or foreground resource pressure. Small native coordination actions retain their separately reviewed 1 GiB start requirement. Preserve the original 954 records, all 32 continuation tasks, 51 blocking edges, 15 modified app files, indexes, configuration, previous runtime and old native pin. Never replay a timed-out mutation without reconciling its recorded outcome. Retain only legitimately issued claim credentials; no claims have been issued for these unassigned continuation tasks.
